# list.docker_config

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: list-resource. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Lists swarm configs as `docker_config` resources, for `terraform query` and bulk import; the provider's host must be a swarm manager. Filters map to the Engine API `GET /configs` filters.

List resources need Terraform >= 1.14 and live in `*.tfquery.hcl` files run
with `terraform query`. Arguments go inside the list block's `config` block.

## Usage

```terraform
# in a *.tfquery.hcl file; run: terraform query
list "docker_config" "<name>" {
  provider = docker
  # include_resource = true   # also return full resource objects
  # limit            = 100
  config {
    # arguments below
  }
}
```

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `labels` | `map(string)` | optional |  |  | Only configs carrying every one of these labels. An empty value matches any value of that label key. |
| `name` | `string` | optional |  |  | Only configs whose name matches, using the Engine API `name` filter (substring or prefix match, as the daemon defines it). |

## Example

```terraform
# Run with `terraform query` (Terraform 1.14+); add `-generate-config-out=imports.tf`
# to write import blocks and resource configuration for what is found.
provider "docker" {}

list "docker_config" "nginx" {
  provider = docker

  config {
    name = "nginx"
  }
}
```
